about: Poor and rich tiers of the street's streetlight and park bench. Each tier model reuses the NORMAL model's IPL placements, so it keeps the normal GLB's pivot: origin at the normal model's bbox centre, not the ground. Rects are [x, y, w, h] in pixels from the image's top-left (Blender v = 1 - y / h). Game lighting is one flat ambient light and no vertex colour: every face shows its albedo flat, so form (undersides, recesses, gilt highlights) is baked into the albedo.
palette_hint: public/textures/map/streetlight.png (pale grey pole, pale-yellow lamp), public/textures/map/parkbench.png (dark brown slats, black iron). Mid values, photo-ish, NearestFilter so every pixel shows. Poor: rust, soot, decay. Rich: dictator kitsch, gold, white/pink marble, red velvet and banners.

pole_front.look: Pole faces seen head-on (front and back). Top of rect = top of the pole (z 7.8), bottom = base collar (z -7.2), about 2 px a unit. Chipped grey-green paint (110,118,108) over rust (130,72,40); rust grows toward the bottom, two rust runs from bolt holes, soot black in the bottom 6 px, a 3x3 dark access-hatch hole at y 25-27.

pole_side.look: Same pole paint for the side faces (+-X), 20 % darker so the square section reads under flat light.

arm_top.look: Arm upper face, U from pole (left) to tip (right). Rusty, lighter (pigeon-dropping specks).

arm_side.look: Arm front/back faces: flaking grey paint, rust runs, sooty toward the tip.

arm_under.look: Arm underside and end cap: dark, 0.55 of the side tone.

head_out.look: Lamp hood outside, top of rect = hood top. Dented rusty grey steel, soot, a lighter rim at the bottom edge (2 px) where the glass sat.

head_in.look: Smashed lamp underside: black-brown interior, a jagged ring of pale blue-grey glass shards around the rim, a broken bulb socket stub (dull brass) in the middle.

base_side.look: Concrete plinth sides, top of rect = plinth top. Grey concrete (118,116,110), dark crack, chipped top edge, soot and grime rising from the bottom 2 px, a rust stain dribbling down from the top.

base_top.look: Concrete plinth top: lighter concrete, rust ring stain round the pole footprint, a chipped corner.

wire.look: Black rubber cable, U across, V along (top = fixed end); 1 px dull highlight column; bottom 3 px frayed copper (180,110,50).

hatch.look: Open access-hatch door: rusty steel plate, a darker riveted border.

shard.look: Glass shards and soot on the pavement: pale blue-grey shard flecks on dark grey.

shaft.look: Fluted shaft, one rect per hexagonal face: two flutes (dark green-black iron, a 1 px gold highlight on each flute edge), top of rect = capital (z0 + 15.0), bottom = base collar (z0 + 3.0). Gilt bands painted at the ends.

base.look: Fluted bell base, top of rect = shoulder (z0 + 3.0), bottom = plinth top (z0 + 0.5). Black iron with gilt flutes, an acanthus-leaf gold band near the bottom, darker toward the bottom edge (occlusion).

finial.look: Cut-out gold finial: a spike over a small red five-point star in a gold ring, alpha 0 around it.

iron.look: Plain black-green iron with a 1 px gilt edge line top and bottom (bars, brackets).

plinth_side.look: White/pink marble plinth side with grey veins, a 1 px gold moulding line under the top edge, soft occlusion at the bottom.

gold_shade.look: Gilt in shadow: deep ochre-brown with a few warm glints (undersides, back faces of collars).

gold_lit.look: Polished gilt, bright: pale-yellow highlights, warm mid gold, a few dark tarnish pixels.

gold_mid.look: Gilt mid-tone: collars and arm sides.

globe.look: Lamp globe, planar-mapped from the front: bright cream-white (255,250,228) disc, warmer and slightly darker to the rim (225,210,170), faint vertical rib lines. Reads as a lit globe with no emissive.

banner.look: Cut-out swallowtail pennant: red cloth (170,25,25) with folds baked as darker vertical bands, a gold fringe at the top bar, a gold-rimmed cream roundel with the leader's black bust (peaked cap, moustache, epaulettes) in the upper half, a gold star under it; the swallowtail notch cut by alpha.

scroll_cross.look: Cut-out gilt brackets under the crossbar: two C-scrolls mirrored about the centre, 2 px thick gold lines with a bright inner edge, alpha 0 between.

scroll_swan.look: Cut-out gilt filigree under the swan-neck arm: a large spiral volute at the pole end (left), a running wave scroll along the arm to the right, leaves; 2 px gold lines with highlights, alpha 0 between.

frame.look: Cut-out cast-iron bench end seen from the side (+X): front leg (left), seat bearer, back leg rising and leaning back into the backrest support, simple armrest. Rusty brown-black iron, flaking. Left of rect = front (-Y), top = top of backrest.

frame_broken.look: Same end with the front leg snapped off at mid-height (jagged), bent armrest, heavier rust.

leg_front.look: Front view of a cast-iron leg (cut-out): 2 px wide post, foot flare at the bottom, rust.

slat_top.look: Weathered slat upper face, U along the 6.4-unit length: grey-brown wood, dark grain, black stains and two rusty bolt dots near each end.

slat_top2.look: Variant slat: more rotten, a long split and a dark wet stain mid-length.

slat_edge.look: Slat edge/end grain: darker than the top (0.6).

slat_broken.look: Half slat with a splintered end at the right (alpha cut jagged), pale fresh wood in the break.

litter.look: Cut-out litter: a crumpled grey newspaper and a green-brown bottle on its side.

end.look: Cut-out gilt bench end seen from the side: lion-paw front leg (left), cabriole back leg, a big rolled armrest scroll ending in a volute at the front top, acanthus filigree between. Gold with bright highlights on the curls and dark ochre in recesses. Left of rect = front (-Y).

volute.look: Cut-out front face of the armrest scroll: a gold spiral volute (front view), highlights on the outer turn.

leg.look: Cut-out front view of a gilt cabriole leg: knee bulge at the top, slim ankle, lion paw at the bottom.

velvet_top.look: Red velvet cushion top, U along the bench: diamond tufting with gold button dots, deep crimson creases, sheen lighter (200,40,45) on the puffs.

velvet_side.look: Cushion front and sides: darker crimson (120,15,20), gold piping line along the top edge.

back_front.look: Backrest front: a gilt frame (2 px) round tufted red velvet, a small gold oval medallion with the leader's black bust at the centre.

back_rear.look: Backrest rear: dark red panel in a gilt frame, plain.

marble_top.look: White marble seat slab top edge strip (pink-grey veins).

marble_edge.look: Marble slab front/back faces: veined white marble, a gold moulding line along the top, darker at the bottom.

crest.look: Cut-out crest above the backrest: gilt laurel C-scrolls, a cream roundel with the leader's black bust (peaked cap, moustache), a red star on top.

env_streetlight_poor.design: Same post layout as the normal: concrete plinth, square pole, arm to +X. The pole bends a few degrees toward +X and the camera above a kink at z -1; the arm sags at its tip; the smashed lamp head hangs 1.6 units under the tip on its wire, tilted so its broken underside shows; a second frayed cable dangles from mid-arm; the access hatch near the base hangs open; glass shards on the ground.

env_streetlight_rich.design: Marble plinth, fluted bell base, fluted hexagonal shaft with a gilt collar, gilt capital; a gilt crossbar on top carrying three cream globes (centre one higher, a gold star finial above); a straight gilt arm with filigree reaching +X like the normal's arm, a hanging globe lantern at its tip; a red pennant with the leader's bust hung from two brackets on the -X side.

env_parkbench_poor.design: Cast-iron ends (cut-out profile quads plus front-leg quads) and wooden slats. One seat slat missing, one snapped with half on the ground, top back slat missing, middle back slat hanging by one end; the +X end's front leg is broken, so that end sags. Litter underneath.

env_parkbench_rich.design: Gilt ends with lion-paw legs and rolled armrests (cut-out profile quads, front volute quads, solid gilt armrest rails), gilt cabriole legs, a white marble seat slab under a tufted red velvet cushion, a red velvet backrest in a gilt frame, a gilt crest with the leader's bust on top, gold ball finials on the back corners.
